question: What should an operator check before restarting pump P-104 after a seal failure?

files.title: P-104 restart checklist
files.text: Before restarting P-104: isolate and lock out the pump, confirm replacement seal installation, inspect alignment, verify lubrication, and complete the supervisor sign-off.

files.title: Mechanical seal inspection
files.text: Inspect the replacement seal for damage, verify flush connections are open, and confirm the pump is primed before a controlled restart.

files.title: P-104 maintenance record
files.text: Work order WO-104: mechanical seal replaced. Alignment verification and supervisor restart authorization are pending.

answer:

question: Can a store run a weekend pop-up, and which safety checks are required?

files.title: Weekend pop-up policy
files.text: Weekend pop-ups require store manager approval, a staffed checkout, and an agreed inventory plan. No event may obstruct emergency exits.

files.title: Pop-up safety checklist
files.text: Confirm unobstructed exits, safe electrical connections, accessible walkways, and an assigned crowd steward before opening.

Yes, with store manager approval, a staffed checkout, and an agreed inventory plan. [ref_id:0]

Before opening, check emergency exits, electrical connections, accessible walkways, and the assigned crowd steward. [ref_id:1]

name: Business performance
description: Explore a cross-source analytical question with a transparent SQL example.
question: Which region missed its Q3 target, and what recovery action does the playbook recommend?

sources.name: sales-data-agent
sources.title: Sales analytics
sources.detail: Fabric Data Agent · synthetic replay · identity required live

files.title: Q3 regional performance
files.text: Synthetic result: North actual $920K vs $1M target (-8%); South actual $1.1M vs $1M target (+10%).

sources.name: sales-playbook
sources.title: Sales recovery playbook
sources.detail: Remote SharePoint · synthetic replay · identity required live

files.title: Regional recovery plan
files.text: For a region below quarterly target, review stalled opportunities, assign executive sponsors to the top five deals, and run a weekly conversion review.

answer:
North missed its Q3 target by $80,000 (8%), while South exceeded its target by 10%. [ref_id:0]

For North, review stalled opportunities, assign executive sponsors to the five largest deals, and run a weekly conversion review. [ref_id:1]
sql:
SELECT region, SUM(actual_revenue) AS actual, SUM(target_revenue) AS target
FROM regional_sales
WHERE fiscal_year = 2026 AND fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY region
HAVING SUM(actual_revenue) < SUM(target_revenue);
